card.name: Linking words before starting treatment
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs such as initiating, initiate, in, or and a comma, in warnings just before the thing being started or done, e.g. 'before initiating treatment' or 'engaging in activities'.

modes.label: Initiating treatment
modes.description: The verb initiate or initiating right before the word treatment or therapy.
modes.example: Test all patients for evidence of current or prior hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection before<< initiating>> treatment with SOVALDI.

modes.label: Linking word before activities
modes.description: A small word like in or or inside a caution about driving or mental alertness.
modes.example: Patients should be warned about engaging<< in>> activities requiring mental alertness and motor coordination

modes.label: List comma
modes.description: A comma before the last item in a list of conditions.
modes.example: used with caution in patients with conditions such as severe constipation, ulcerative colitis<<,>> and myasthenia gravis.
